name: sori
description: Sori on any OS from Claude Code, Claude Desktop or Cowork, no app to install: /sori:setup (one-time environment, doctor, repair), /sori:transcribe (one episode or video, free, local), /sori:shows (subscriptions and settings), /sori:sweep (every Auto show, headless), /sori:train (transcript to deck + study guide; free by default, the API route is optional and paid).
